title: Retail & E-commerce product catalogue, version 1
sourceDescription: Selected product evidence from current vendor pages, checked on 21 November 2026. Claims state what the vendor describes, not proven suitability for an organisation. Editorial review is pending. Coverage spans the sector’s main capability areas but is not exhaustive; a missing product is not evidence that no product exists.

entries.summary: An enterprise commerce platform for online selling.

claims.statement: The vendor describes Shopify Plus as an enterprise commerce platform for online selling.

entries.summary: A commerce platform for online storefronts and orders.

claims.statement: The vendor describes Adobe Commerce as a commerce platform for online storefronts and orders.

entries.summary: Software for managing product information across selling channels.

claims.statement: The vendor describes Akeneo PIM as software for managing product information across selling channels.

entries.summary: Software for warehouse operations and inventory execution.

capabilities.name: Warehouse Operations
capabilities.howItSupports: Coordinates warehouse tasks and stock movements

claims.statement: The vendor describes Blue Yonder Warehouse Management as software for warehouse operations and inventory execution.

entries.summary: Order management software for omnichannel fulfilment.

capabilities.name: Click & Collect and Returns
capabilities.howItSupports: Supports fulfilment choices including collection and returns

claims.statement: The vendor describes Manhattan Active Order Management as order management software for omnichannel fulfilment.

entries.summary: Point of sale software for retail stores.

capabilities.name: Point of Sale
capabilities.howItSupports: Handles in-store selling and service transactions

claims.statement: The vendor describes Oracle Retail Xstore as point of sale software for retail stores.

entries.summary: Customer loyalty software for online retailers.

capabilities.name: Loyalty & Offers
capabilities.howItSupports: Manages loyalty programmes and customer rewards

claims.statement: The vendor describes LoyaltyLion as customer loyalty software for online retailers.
